evidence: Substantially modifies witness stack deserialization and execution paths across src/script/script.{h,cpp}, src/script/interpreter.cpp, and src/validation.cpp.
rationale: Optimizes witness parsing and execution paths to eliminate significant CPU overhead during block validation. Benchmarks demonstrate substantial gains, such as total receipt-to-accept/reject time dropping from 128ms to 14ms on synthetic blocks with 2.0M 1-byte witness items and 5-7x faster CompactSize iteration.
